correctness.rationale: Every idempotent is the predecessor map of its fixed-point set. Pointwise commuting forces a Catalan map on the fixed points and a block map into the corresponding target block. Strictly increasing target-block labels give independent binomial/Catalan local counts, while equal adjacent labels force the earlier block to be constant. The weighted sum and two-state transition are exhaustive and non-overlapping; all arithmetic works for n=1 and k=1. Actual independent direct-composition enumeration of every idempotent through n=9 matched the weighted sum and recurrence, although finite checks do not replace proof.

value.rationale: Centralizers are natural commutation invariants controlling the local multiplicative structure of finite transformation monoids. The classification gives the exact centralizer of EVERY predecessor idempotent, including non-idempotent elements, with weights dictated by projection-block geometry; the quadratic algorithm scales with number of fixed blocks. A six-point same-rank pair proves the rank alone does not determine this invariant. It is a complete family result, not an arbitrary tiny computation or a routine restatement of Catalan cardinalities.
